<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XXV.|ACCORDING TO S. MATTHEW.|73 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>I sow not, & gather vvhere I stravved not: {{verse|chapter=25|verse=27}}† thou oughtest therfore to haue committed my money to the bankers, and comming I might haue receiued mine ovvne ‖ vvith vsurie. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=28}}† Take ye avvay therfore the talent from him, and giue it him that hath ten talents. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=29}}† For to {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 13, 12. Lu. 8, 18.''}}* euery one that hath shal be giuen, and he shal abound: but from him that hath not, ‖ that also vvhich he seemeth to haue, shal be taken avvay from him. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=30}}† And the vnprofitable seruant cast ye out into the vtter darknesse. There shal be vveeping and gnashing of teeth.

{{verse|chapter=25|verse=31}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō munday the first weeke of Lent.}}And vvhen the sonne of man shal come in his maiestie, and al the Angels vvith him, then shal he sitte vpon the seate of his maiestie: {{verse|chapter=25|verse=32}}† and al nations shal be gathered together before him, and he shal ‖ separate them one from an other, as the pastor separateth the sheepe from the goates: {{verse|chapter=25|verse=33}}† and shal set the sheepe at his right hand, but the goates at his left. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=34}}† Then shal the king say to them that shal be at his right hand, Come ye blessed of my father, possesse you the kingdom {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This kingdō then is prepared for those onely that do good workes: as Christ also signifieth els where, saying that it is not in his power to giue it otherwise. ''See the annot. c. 20, 23''.}}∷ prepared for you from the foundation of the vvorld. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=35}}† for I vvas an hungred, and ‖ you gaue me to eate: I vvas a thirst, and you gaue me to drinke. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=36}}† I vvas a stranger, and you tooke me in: naked, and you couered me: sicke, and you visited me. I vvas in prison, and you came to me. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=37}}† Then shal the iust ansvver him, saying: Lord, vvhen did vve see thee an hungred, and fed thee: a thirst, and gaue thee drinke? {{verse|chapter=25|verse=38}}† and vvhen did vve see thee a stranger, and tooke thee in? or naked, and couered thee? {{verse|chapter=25|verse=39}}† or vvhen did vve see thee sicke or in prison: and came to thee? {{verse|chapter=25|verse=40}}† And the king ansvvering, shall say to them, Amen I say to you, as long as you did it to one of these my least brethren, you did it to me. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=41}}† Then he shal say to them also that shal be at his left hand, ‖ Get ye avvay from me you cursed into fire euerlasting, vvhich vvas prepared for the Deuil and his angels. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=42}}† for I vvas an hungred, and you ‖ gaue me not to eate: I vvas a thirst, and you gaue me not to drinke. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=43}}† I Was a stranger, and you tooke me not in: naked, and you couered me not: sicke, and in prison, and you did not visite me. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=44}}† Then they also shall ansvver him, saying, Lord, vvhen did vve see thee an hungred, or a thirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sicke, or in prison: and did not minister to thee? {{verse|chapter=25|verse=45}}† Then he shal ansvver them, saying, Amen I say to you, as long as you did it not to one of these lesser, neither did you it to me. {{verse|chapter=25|verse=46}}† And these shal goe into punishment euerlasting: but the iust, into life euerlasting.⊣<noinclude>{{rh||K|ANNOT-}}</noinclude>
